note: 정형쿼리 후보. NL2SQL 실행 계정(sql_retriever_user) 권한으로 EXPLAIN만 수행해 문법과 권한을 확인함. 회원 범위는 RLS와 세션 변수가 정하므로 SQL에 회원 조건을 쓰지 않음.

queries.name: 보유 카드 목록
queries.description: 기준일 현재 보유 카드와 상품, 연회비
queries.sql: SELECT card_ref, product_name, brand, issue_date, current_status, annual_fee FROM app.customer_cards ORDER BY card_ref

queries.name: 카드별 월 이용금액
queries.sql: SELECT card_ref, month, approved_amount, transaction_count FROM app.monthly_usage ORDER BY month, card_ref

queries.name: 월별 이용금액 합계
queries.description: 최근 6개월 모든 카드를 합친 월별 승인 이용금액과 건수
queries.sql: SELECT month, sum(approved_amount)::bigint AS approved_amount, sum(transaction_count)::integer AS transaction_count FROM app.monthly_usage GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

queries.name: 최근 연체 현황
queries.description: 기준일 이전에 마감된 월 가운데 가장 최근 연체 정보
queries.sql: SELECT base_month, as_of_date, overdue_amount, overdue_days, overdue_count_12m FROM app.customer_delinquency

queries.name: 연체 이력
queries.sql: SELECT base_month, as_of_date, overdue_amount, overdue_days, overdue_count_12m FROM app.customer_delinquency_history ORDER BY base_month

queries.name: 일별 이용금액
queries.sql: SELECT usage_date, approved_amount, transaction_count FROM app.customer_daily_usage ORDER BY usage_date

queries.name: 업종별 이용금액
queries.sql: SELECT category, sum(approved_amount)::bigint AS approved_amount, sum(transaction_count)::integer AS transaction_count FROM app.merchant_usage GROUP BY category ORDER BY approved_amount DESC

queries.name: 가맹점 이용 상위 10곳
queries.sql: SELECT merchant_name, category, sum(approved_amount)::bigint AS approved_amount, sum(transaction_count)::integer AS transaction_count FROM app.merchant_usage GROUP BY merchant_name, category ORDER BY approved_amount DESC LIMIT 10
